content.description: Pixl.Page let's you create personal pages with your NFTs and will become everyone's NFT and Web3 profile page. Select NFTs from your wallet, add them to your page and curate your NFT collection. Your fully customizable Pixl.Page will give you the freedom to build your identity around your NFT holdings and added social features will allow you to discover NFTs and connect with other collectors. Finally, you decide what your collection looks like! Powered by NANO Frames ( www.nano-frames.com ). Pixl.
